metadata.title: Clicked like a squirrel on turbo mode and somehow popped a dude? Valorant aim is drunk again
metadata.description:
Me: smashing buttons like it’s a panic dance
Enemy: probably wondering what hit them
How did I even land that kill? No clue, but I’m cashing in
Click if your chaos aim ever surprises even YOU!

Tap if your aim ever goes rogue but still gets a kill!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
